label: sound
instruction_covers: Importer() defaults csv, gdocs, epicollect, s3, localCSV, iiif; register_* adds flickr, dropbox, twitter, youtube on that instance
get_all_importer_names and get_autoimporter_names excluding dropbox and s3; instances keep independent registries
count_tasks_to_import merges registered credentials and returns the source count without saving
create_tasks copies every yielded key onto the task, dedups via task_repo.get_task_by(project_id, info), and returns the three exact ImportReport messages, totals, and metadata
ImportReport(message, metadata, total) exposes those properties
notes: The importer module is missing at base (pybossa/importers/__init__.py imports .importer, which is absent), so this is a new API fully specified by the instruction. Tests patch pybossa.importers.importer.BulkTaskFlickrImport and assert state/n_answers/priority_0/quorum, which is the stated 'copy each yielded key'. Exact report strings are quoted. No extra contract.
